up: Retrieve all unique compounds that are associated with the document having ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3886604. For each compound, provide its ChEMBL identifier (from molecule_dictionary) and its canonical SMILES (from compound_structures). Only include compounds that have a SMILES recorded. The compounds are linked to the document via the compound_records table (doc_id). Use the docs table to locate the document by its chembl_id. Return the result with distinct compound rows.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3886604'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL;
